name: Contractor identity-document evidence
scope: Mandatory contractor identity-card front and back photos
Private Drive storage and immutable signature evidence
Personal-data purpose notice and consent v2
requiresDatabases: Existing Engineering contract PostgreSQL signatures evidence_snapshot

dataIsolation.guard: Identity images remain below the Engineering private signing-session Drive folder. Only hashes, private references and received metadata enter immutable Engineering signature evidence.

changes: Require both contractor identity-card sides before signature submission
Resize in the browser and validate bytes and limits again on the server
Store both files in a private confidential session folder
Bind refs, hashes, sizes, MIME types and received times to immutable signature evidence
Verify both originals again during final completion
Expose only received times and hashes in the signed PDF and receipt
definitionOfDone: Either missing side fails closed with no signature
Both files pass private Drive audit and SHA-256 storage
Immutable signature evidence contains both document records
No identity image or private ref is exposed in LINE, draft review or signed PDF
Relevant dry-runs and package validation pass
